recipes.name: Pickled radish (Chicken-mu: 치킨무)
ingredients: 1 pound (about 450 g) peeled Korean radish, cut into ⅓-inch (about 8 mm) cubes
⅓ cup plus 1 tablespoon white vinegar
instructions: Combine sugar, vinegar, kosher salt, and water in a large bowl and mix well until salt and sugar are well dissolved.

Add the radish and stir a few times, then transfer to an airtight container or a glass jar. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving, until the radish absorbs the sweet and sour brine. Keep refrigerated for up to 2 weeks.
